calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
t AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM h) holdout,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t) targeted,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h JOIN t USING(member_id)) overlap,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) h_not_in_dim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15) rows_h,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) exp_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date > DATE '2025-11-24')) joined_after

calls.statement:
WITH cons AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE marketing_consent AND DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to),
h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
t AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cons) consenting_at_start,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h JOIN cons USING(member_id)) h_consent,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t JOIN cons USING(member_id)) t_consent,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cons WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM h) AND member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM t)) cons_neither,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM cons)) h_noconsent,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM cons)) t_noconsent,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) dups

calls.statement:
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.mailing_list_size, c.holdout_size, round(100.0*c.holdout_size/c.mailing_list_size,2) pct, c.mailing_list_size*0.1 tenpct,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) targeted
FROM dim_campaign c ORDER BY 1
